paragraphs.S08.C000.P000: On the morning of the fourth day, Alice left her notebook in the room for ten minutes, as she had promised over the cards. During that time, Eric played the song she had assigned him in the car, and Damir returned from the bakery with the driest bun he could find—both had completed their card tasks. When Alice went back to her notebook, she did not write down everything, only Nick's yellow hat and the way Eric kept quietly humming the chorus after turning off the music.

S08.C001.title: If Alice sat beside Damir in S05-C1

paragraphs.S08.C001.P000: On the stairs, Damir asked whether she had rested after yesterday's drive. He did not mention their silence in the car; Alice understood anyway which hour he was asking about.
paragraphs.S08.C001.P001: “I did. Thank you for simply sitting beside me then.”

paragraphs.S08.C002.P000: The strap on Alice's backpack tore in the hallway. Her water bottle rolled down the stairs and stopped at Damir's feet.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P004: “For gear. I wouldn't suggest using a medical needle to repair a backpack.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P006: Damir sat on a step, but did not take the backpack.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P007: “Do you want me to fix it?”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P008: Alice could have refused simply because, two years ago, he often did useful things before she had time to decide whether she needed them. But now he waited.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P009: “Show me what you're going to do first.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P010: He laid out a small kit: a thick needle, thread, and a strip of webbing.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P011: “I'll reinforce both sides. It won't be pretty.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P012: “It worries me how often you and Eric warn people that something won't be pretty.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P016: She handed him the backpack. Damir sewed slowly, biting his lip as he pushed the needle through the dense fabric. Alice remembered him sewing a button onto his shirt before their first New Year's Eve together. He had been just as focused then, as if someone's life depended on the result.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P017: “You still make that face,” she said.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P019: “As if the backpack might not survive the operation.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P022: “The water bottle is waiting in the hallway.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P023: They laughed. The laughter came too easily, and Alice felt fear rising behind it: if being together was still easy, did that mean two years had changed nothing?
paragraphs.S08.C002.P024: Damir finished the stitch and tugged at the strap.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P026: She put on the backpack. The strap held.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P030: “I started cycling in Brussels,” he said. “That's the scar. And that's why I always carry the kit.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P031: “You could have told me that on the first evening.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P032: “I could have. But you didn't have to listen to a whole story because of one question.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P033: That was new. The old Damir would have explained everything—the route, the rain, the speed, the emergency department—and only afterward noticed that the conversation had taken twenty minutes.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P034: “What about the meeting in Akureyri?” Alice asked.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P035: “They're offering a year-long program. I haven't answered yet.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P036: “Because you're looking at the place first?”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P037: “And because I don't want to make decisions only because they look reasonable on paper anymore.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P038: He did not add ‘after us.’ Alice was grateful, and a little disappointed, that he did not.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P039: When Alice was about to leave, Nick came into the hallway and stopped by the door.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P042: Nick looked down. He had a boot on his left foot and a sock on his right.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P043: “I count this one as the first.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P044: “The second is by the radiator,” Alice said. “You put it there to dry after the trail.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P045: “Why do you know more about my footwear than I do?”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P047: Nick left, but returned a second later.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P048: “By the way, in fifteen minutes I want to film a short introduction to the road from each of you. No personal questions. You can both refuse.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P050: “What does an introduction to the road mean?”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P051: “One object you always bring, and why.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P053: “Fine. Then the object and a false reason.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P055: Fifteen minutes later, they gathered by the car. Eric brought an old metal thermos with a dent in its side.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P056: “The reason?” Nick asked from behind the camera.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P057: “It's useful for hammering in tent pegs.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P060: Alice showed them a thin notebook.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P061: “I use it as a shim under uneven tables.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P062: Nick pointed the camera at Damir. He was holding the repair kit.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P063: “It keeps me from using hotel sewing kits.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P065: “Then: I use it to fend off journalists.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P069: Nick put the camera on a tripod and stepped into the frame himself. His hands were empty.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P073: “This is an introduction to the car, not the road.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P074: Nick stepped out of the frame, found a small toy spinning top in his pocket, and showed it to them.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P077: “I use it to check whether a surface is level.”
paragraphs.S08.C002.P078: He spun the top on the hood. It turned and fell toward Eric.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P079: “The car is parked on a slope,” Eric said.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P081: Nick stopped recording and showed them the footage at once. In the frame, they did not look like the heroes of a future story, but like people who had not yet decided who they would be beside one another.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P085: Damir asked him to remove the last second, in which he looked at Alice after the joke. Nick rewound, confirmed the boundary, and trimmed it in front of them.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P088: Alice noticed that, for the first time on the trip, Damir had asked to change something that concerned him instead of enduring it for everyone else's convenience. Perhaps a new life was made of exactly these small requests, too inexpressive for grand confessions.
paragraphs.S08.C002.P089: Nick and Eric stayed by the car to put away the camera and check the luggage. Alice and Damir went back to the guesthouse for their jackets and the thermos. In the hall, they found themselves alone again.

paragraphs.S08.C004.P000: “I was going to make coffee. Would you like one?”
paragraphs.S08.C004.P001: Damir looked at her with a careful pleasure he did not manage to hide.
paragraphs.S08.C004.P002: “If you're going to the kitchen anyway. Black.”
paragraphs.S08.C004.P003: They stood by the window with hot mugs. He told her that he had tried to find the kind of apples he was used to at the shop yesterday and bought pears because he was embarrassed to ask the seller for the third time. Alice laughed at him, not at their past. When they finished their coffee, she was the first to say she needed to put on her jacket before the walk. Damir nodded and stayed to wash both mugs.

paragraphs.S08.C005.P000: “Thank you for the backpack. I'll go get my jacket.”
paragraphs.S08.C005.P002: Damir stepped aside to let her pass. On the stairs, Alice looked back: he was not watching her go, but trying to close his overstuffed backpack. She did not help. There were a few minutes left before they went out to the car, and what they had said was enough for both of them.

paragraphs.S08.C006.P000: “Did you like Brussels? Not the work. Brussels itself.”
paragraphs.S08.C006.P001: Damir lowered his eyes to the handle of her backpack.
paragraphs.S08.C006.P002: “Sometimes. I have friends there. On Sundays we rode out of town, though I was the worst at keeping my balance on wet roads.”
paragraphs.S08.C006.P004: He smiled, but did not return to the old story.
paragraphs.S08.C006.P005: “The first winter was difficult. Then I found a home I wanted to return to. By the end, I understood that I could leave without losing everything that had been there.”
paragraphs.S08.C006.P006: Alice did not know whether she was glad to hear that answer. She asked him to show her a picture from those Sundays someday, if he wanted to. Damir said, “All right,” and did not reach for his phone immediately.
